slides.headline: AI CAN FORECAST YOUR QUARTER, FIND YOUR WORST PRODUCT, AND CATCH EVERY SILENT COST IN 60 SECONDS
slides.kicker: FREE. PASTE YOUR NUMBERS IN TONIGHT.
slides.image_prompt: Magnifying glass over spreadsheet with $ and warning triangle symbols, olive green accounting visor and cash beside, wooden market table, daylight.

slides.headline: 1) FIND THE CUSTOMERS QUIETLY LEAVING YOU
slides.body: Businesses lose 20, 30% of their customers silently every year: no complaint, no goodbye, just gone. Paste 12 months of purchase history and AI ranks who to contact first by lifetime spend.

slides.headline: 2) SPOT THE PRODUCT DRAINING YOUR MARGINS
slides.body: Most businesses have one service that looks busy but quietly eats the bottom line. Paste revenue and cost by product; AI tells you whether to raise the price, cut the cost, or drop it.

slides.headline: 3) FORECAST YOUR NEXT QUARTER IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: Every serious fund builds a quarterly projection before committing capital. Paste six months of revenue numbers and AI returns a best case, worst case, and most likely number, with the math shown.

slides.headline: 4) FIND THE ONE STEP SLOWING EVERYTHING ELSE DOWN
slides.body: Fix just that one bottleneck step and your capacity can double without hiring anyone. Paste every process step and its time; AI finds the single delay and models cutting it in half.

slides.headline: 5) CATCH EVERY COST THAT CREPT UP ON YOU
slides.body: Expenses climb 10, 20% a year without anyone deciding to spend more. Paste three months of expenses by category; AI finds what grew more than 10% and ranks the top three cuts.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS. PASTE YOUR NUMBERS IN TONIGHT.
slides.body: Every prompt works inside ChatGPT or Claude. Paste your real data and the analysis takes under a minute. Daily AI skills and business tools, every day.
